sources.title: Apple Support — Connect to HDMI from your Mac
quotes: HDMI port: Connect directly to HDMI with an HDMI cable.
For 8K connections, use an Ultra High Speed 48 Gbps HDMI cable
Thunderbolt 5, Thunderbolt 4, Thunderbolt 3, or USB-C port: Connect to HDMI with an adapter such as the Apple USB-C Digital AV Multiport Adapter

You can connect a display with a resolution of up to 8K at 60Hz to the HDMI port on these Mac models: MacBook Pro with M4, M5, M2 Pro, M3 Pro, M4 Pro, M5 Pro, M2 Max, M3 Max, M4 Max, or M5 Max introduced in 2023 or later

You can connect a display with a resolution of up to 4K at 240Hz to the HDMI port on these Mac models: MacBook Pro with M4, M5, M2 Pro, M3 Pro, M4 Pro, M5 Pro, M2 Max, M3 Max, M4 Max, or M5 Max introduced in 2023 or later
Adapters aren't supported for these resolutions and refresh rates.

You can connect a display with a resolution up to 4K at 60Hz to the HDMI port on these Mac models: Mac Studio introduced in 2022 or later Mac mini introduced in 2018 or later Mac Pro introduced in 2019 or later MacBook Pro introduced in 2021 or later

You can connect a display with a resolution up to 4K at 30Hz to the HDMI port on these Mac models: Mac mini introduced in 2012 through 2014 Mac Pro introduced in 2013 MacBook Pro introduced in 2012 through 2015
If using an adapter, check the specifications of the adapter to learn about supported resolutions and other details.

sources.title: Apple Support — About the Apple USB-C Digital AV Multiport Adapter
quotes: Model A2119 is the newest model of this adapter.

It supports these resolutions and refresh rates when used with macOS Mojave 10.14.6 or later or iOS 12.4 or later. 3840 x 2160 at 60Hz with these devices: 16-inch MacBook Pro introduced in 2019 or later 15-inch MacBook Pro introduced in 2017 or later 14-inch MacBook Pro introduced in 2021 or later 13-inch MacBook Pro with Apple silicon introduced in 2020 or later 13-inch MacBook Pro with four Thunderbolt 3 ports introduced in 2020 MacBook Air introduced in 2020 or later
3840 x 2160 at 30Hz with these devices: 13-inch MacBook Pro introduced in 2016 or later MacBook introduced in 2015 or later
Model A1621 supports these resolutions and refresh rates when used with macOS Sierra 10.12 or later or iOS 12 or later: 3840 x 2160 at 30Hz Up to 1080p at 60Hz

sources.title: HDMI LA — Ultra96 HDMI Cable and Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable
quotes: It is applicable for system configurations supporting up to 48Gbps maximum bandwidth.
The Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable was introduced in the HDMI 2.1 Specification
